features.title: Individual & joint applicant identity capture
features.description: Web form allowing a customer to enter personal and identity details for themselves and, optionally, a joint applicant.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can enter name, date of birth, address, and government ID number
Customer can add a joint applicant with the same required fields
Form validates required fields before submission
Submitted data is persisted and linked to a new application record
nfr_mapping: Data privacy (PII encryption at rest and in transit)

metadata.reasoning: Derived from acceptance criterion covering identity submission, explicitly including joint applicants.
metadata.citation: EP-01: 'Customer can submit identity details online, including for a joint applicant'

features.title: KYC document upload
features.description: Allows the customer to upload ID and proof-of-address documents for verification.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can upload ID and proof-of-address documents
System validates file type and size before accepting
Uploaded documents are linked to the application record
nfr_mapping: Data privacy (PII encryption at rest and in transit)

metadata.reasoning: Directly derived from the document upload acceptance criterion.
metadata.citation: EP-01: 'Customer can upload supporting documents (ID, proof of address)'

features.title: Compliance review & decision workflow
features.description: Gives a compliance officer a queue of submitted applications with the ability to approve or reject with a coded reason.
acceptance_criteria: Officer can view a queue of pending applications
Officer can approve or reject with a structured reason code
Decision and reason are recorded in an audit trail
nfr_mapping: Audit trail for all compliance decisions

metadata.reasoning: Combines the review acceptance criterion with the audit trail NFR at the epic level.
metadata.citation: EP-01: 'Compliance officer can review, approve, or reject submissions with a reason code'
metadata.trajectory: Stable; future automated risk scoring is out of scope.

features.title: Status notifications
features.description: Sends the customer an email notification at each stage transition of their application.
acceptance_criteria: Customer is notified by email on submission
Customer is notified by email on approval or rejection
Rejection notification includes the reason and resubmission instructions

metadata.reasoning: Directly derived from the notification acceptance criterion.
metadata.citation: EP-01: 'Customer receives status notifications by email at each stage transition'
metadata.trajectory: Could expand to SMS/in-app in a later release.

features.title: Application resubmission
features.description: Allows a customer whose application was rejected to correct and resubmit it once.
acceptance_criteria: Rejected customer can edit previously submitted identity/document data
System enforces a single resubmission attempt
Resubmission routes back into the compliance review queue
nfr_mapping: Audit trail for all compliance decisions

metadata.reasoning: Directly derived from the resubmission acceptance criterion; resubmission limit of one is explicit in the epic.
metadata.citation: EP-01: 'Rejected applications can be resubmitted once with corrected information'

features.title: External bank transfer funding
features.description: Allows a customer to initiate funding of their new account from an external bank account.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can enter external account details and transfer amount
Transfer request is submitted for processing
Customer sees a pending status until funds clear

metadata.reasoning: Directly derived from the bank transfer funding acceptance criterion.
metadata.citation: EP-02: 'Customer can initiate a funding transfer from an external bank account'

features.title: Debit card funding
features.description: Allows a customer to fund their account instantly via debit card with real-time confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can enter debit card details
System processes payment and confirms in real time
Funded amount reflects in balance immediately on success

metadata.reasoning: Directly derived from the debit card funding acceptance criterion, carrying the PCI-DSS NFR.
metadata.citation: EP-02: 'Customer can fund via debit card with real-time confirmation'

features.title: Balance view
features.description: Displays the customer's current account balance after a funding transaction completes.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can view current balance after successful funding
Balance updates reflect both transfer and card funding sources

metadata.reasoning: Directly derived from the balance-viewing acceptance criterion.
metadata.citation: EP-02: 'Customer can view current balance after funding completes'
metadata.trajectory: Stable; will later show transaction history.
